notes.title: Office Fight is Crashing into Steam Scream Fest! 👻
notes.content:
Get Ready to Scream! 😱 
We're very excited to announce that Office Fight is crashing into Steam Scream Fest from Oct 26 to Nov 2! You can enjoy our bone-crunching combat as you climb the corporate ladder for revenge!

AND... Come join the Fenix dev team as we stream Office Fight LIVE on Steam for Scream Fest! 👻

🗓️ Stream 1:
🕛 MON, 28 OCT 2024
🕚 10AM PST / 1PM EDT / 4AM AEDT

🗓️ Stream 2:
🕛 WED, 30 OCT 2024
🕚 2PM PST / 5PM EDT / 8AM AEDT

We'll be happily answering any questions and hanging out with y'all across the rest of Spooktober!

See you then... If you dare? 😱

<3 The Fenix Team

notes.title: Office Fight is Going Mobile! 📱
notes.content:
🚀 Office Fight is Going Mobile! 🚀
We’ve been hard at work improving Office Fight and making huge improvements where possible. Our team is small, but we're incredibly excited to announce that we're bringing an early version of Office Fight to mobile! 📱

We’re starting small by launching a playtesting build over on the Google Play Store.

We've heard from so many of you about how perfect Office Fight would be as a mobile game, and we can't wait to bring this fun puzzle destruction simulator to life on handheld devices!

A huge thank you for all the support and love so far🙏. If you're interested in hanging out with other Office Fighters and our Dev Team, or just wanted to provide some valuable feedback, come and join our Official Discord Server!

notes.title: Office Fight OUT NOW! + Our Two Weeks Notice Campaign
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44822215/06fc6fae7176dad7dfe6f1d91979c45e96062fd9.png

🎉 Office Fight is Out Now! 🎉

We’re thrilled to announce that we launched Office Fight last week! 🥂

But while we're excited about our game's release, we can't ignore the harsh reality that many of our fellow developers are still facing waves of layoffs. Too many amazing games never get the chance to see the light of day.

It's a tough time for the games industry, and we feel it deeply.

After our team was laid off, we decided to come together to create Fenix Studios and develop Office Fight as a bit of cathartic relief. (Because, let’s be honest, who hasn’t fantasized about launching their monitor at the office Karen? And for the tenth time, this meeting could’ve been an emaillll..)

We know Office Fight won't solve the bigger problems in the industry, but we hope it can bring a smile to someone’s face — even if it’s just from lobbing a virtual coffee cup across the office.

Our Two Weeks Notice Campaign
As part of our celebrations of release, we launched our Two Weeks Notice Campaign. If you've recently been made redundant, we’d love to offer you a free copy of Office Fight. Head over to our website to claim your copy!

This campaign ends on Wednesday the 4th of September, so make sure you reach out before then!

P.S. 👀 Looking to add some personal flair to your Office Fight experience? You can customize your levels and characters… (For legal reasons, we're not saying you can recreate your very frustrating boss, but we're also not saying you can't RKO them in-game 😉)

notes.title: Pre-launch Update
notes.content:
Hey Spreadsheet Surfers,

Launch time is almost here! 

Just as a reminder, here are our launch times for various time zones for 21st August:

11pm AEST (Australia East)
9pm JST (Japan)
6pm IST (India)
2pm BST (UK)
10am BRT (Brazil)
9am EDT (New York)
6am PST (California)

It's been a wild ride for us at Fenix Studios but we couldn't have done it without you guys. Not just the new followers on our many socials, but especially those from our old steam page who were kind enough to leave reviews. We wholeheartedly welcome you to leave another review on release!

Also a huge thanks to those of you who wishlisted recently, we're extremely grateful for your support!

Since this is our first ever title, we've learnt so much about the game development world. Especially how hard it is to market a game! Hopefully next time, we can do things better and more efficiently. 

The only thing left for us to do now is try and get the wishlist count up as much as we can, right up to launch time. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44822215/231a4ec16ea1b5b79dea90c6ed2d60ea4cbcdda3.png


Launch Campaign: more details soon...

We at Fenix Studios are no strangers to redundancies. Many of our own developers have been made redundant before. Office Fight's existence, while mostly just for fun, hopefully brings a bit more awareness into the world about job loss, lay-offs, and overall workplace frustration. 

To celebrate the launch, we're planning something special in regards to this sentiment. You could even be getting the game for free! This will be a limited window however, so wishlisting will help you stay up to date as this unfolds.

Many thanks again and we'll be posting another update on launch,

- Fenix Studios

notes.title: We saw. We listened. We tweaked.
notes.content:
Hello fellow Office Fighters! 

Huge thank you to everyone who grabbed our demo during Steam Next Fest! If you haven't though, make sure to give it a go...

While getting our final game ready for launch we sat as a team and went over all the valuable feedback you gave us. Question is... what did we learn?

Scoring and Multipliers
Seems our scoring needed a little more TLC and explanation as to how this works in the game. 

We agree! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44822215/fa8c55b733b2ce3d044f6a4b9094b312e3019852.gif

To make these more clear and fun, we've tweaked our explanations about the scoring and how the multipliers work AND added some visual upgrades to the multipliers to provide more player feedback. 

Destruction and physics

Turns out the destruction wasn't quite destructive enough... 

A-GREED.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44822215/2e71668fbca2ea4a2ee19a6e8f9bba0c3d450465.png

We've gone in and upgraded the destruction to be more realistic and more satisfying. How? We made the weight and velocity of an object contribute more to the physics. Desks now break more like desks and rocks fall apart like rocks. 

Continue to hit us up with your feedback! 

Love,

The Office Fight Team

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44822215/fbf3f9ccca9bc1b5a243e9edd24a7656c1f400e3.png

notes.title: Office Fight: Meet the devs who got revenge on 'Mega Corp' by making a game
notes.content:
Ever been made redundant with no notice? Yeah, we hear ya! Work sucks. Break stuff!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44822215/b03f89ec7c1f97b896fa1e4193b313a87ffd7622.png

Throw a middle finger up at corporate b*&lsh#t with us as we walk you through the wicked features and cathartic fun that is our casual office destruction sim.

What’s the story?

You have been unfairly laid off by MegaCorp and the news kills you. Literally. But your restless ghost has unfinished business… REVENGE! 

Watch as we play through the levels, flinging mugs at HR, setting off insane chain reactions and starting hilarious office ragdoll brawls. 

Listen as we talk through the process of creating our zombified Mega Corp employees who you can turn into your own customizable characters... watch them get beaten up in levels.

Discover the history behind the scarily accurate bosses at Mega Corp, like Karon from Customer Service and Count the blood-thirsty Head of Accounting.

Our artists share some of the ol' artwork from the beginning and how Office Fight's style developed. 

Learn about the rollercoaster ride that is indie game development and what the greatest challenges have been. Learn from our many mistakes... so many... 

Ask the burning questions! Like “Does the ‘real’ Mega Corp know you’re making this game?” also “Is Rick single?”, “Did Nick really wrestle a crocodile for money?”, and "What prank did Milly and David pull on Daniel, and where can it be seen in the game?"
